Name: Animated Gemstones - DGA Conversion
Author: GaLaxY256
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][size=4][color=#6d9eeb]A[/color][color=#3d85c6]n[/color][color=#9900ff]i[/color][color=#ff0000]m[/color][color=#ff7700]a[/color][color=#ffff00]t[/color][color=#6aa84f]e[/color][color=#3c78d8]d[/color][color=#8e7cc3] [/color][color=#3d85c6]G[/color][color=#674ea7]e[/color][color=#ff0000]m[/color][color=#ff7700]s[/color][color=#ffff00]t[/color][color=#93c47d]o[/color][color=#3c78d8]n[/color][color=#3d85c6]e[/color][color=#674ea7]s[/color]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=4][color=#cc0000]Dynamic[/color] [color=#76a5af]Game[/color] [color=#6d9eeb]Assets[/color] [color=#f1c232]Conversion[/color] by [/size][color=#ff7700][size=4]GaLaxY256[/size]

[/color][/font][/center] ﻿ ﻿[font=Georgia][size=3]This is the Dynamic Game Assets conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/12004908]undare[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4986]Animated Gemstones[/url] mod, featuring 58 animations added for gemstones and minerals with the rest static (no animated). This conversion has little to no performance hit compared to Content Patcher Animations.﻿
﻿ ﻿(If you only want to use all static, check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8769]Sharp Gemstones[/url] from undare)

[/size][/font][size=4][font=Verdana]INSTALLATION:[/font]
[list]
[*] [font=Verdana]﻿[/font][font=Georgia]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url]﻿ and its requirements. (Optional: Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Config Mod Menu[/url]﻿ for ease of changing config files)[/font]
[*] [font=Georgia]Download and install this mod.[/font]
[*] [font=Georgia]Enjoy! :)[/font]
[/list][font=Georgia]
[b]CONFIGURATION OPTIONS:[/b]
[list]
[*] ﻿Every gemstone can be enabled/disabled by editing config.json generated after running the game with mod installed. For the ease of changing config though, it is recommended to use GMCM(linked above) instead of manually editing config.json.
[/list][/font][/size]
[size=3][b]KNOWN ISSUES:[/b]
[list]
[*] ﻿At the moment, config options doesn't seem to work. I don't know which caused that but I am not sure I can fix this.
[*] ﻿You can only use one DGA pack and the game will not load multiple DGA pack that modifies the same type of icons (e.g. Animated Gemstones and Better Gemstones Animated will not work when used together.)
[/list][/size][size=1](Also please endorse this mod if you love it as it helps me a lot <3 )[/size]
